predictions.prediction_text: The market will see vol selling consolidation this week and potential stabilization into April OpEx.
predictions.expected_result: Volatility measures (e.g., VIX, realized vol) decline or flatten over the coming week and remain lower through April options expiration compared with immediate prior spikes.

predictions.prediction_text: Yield curve will continue bull-steepening as investors expect central banks to ease monetary policy.
predictions.expected_result: Short-term yields fall relative to long-term yields, producing a steeper 2s10s (or similar) curve over coming days.

predictions.prediction_text: Carry trade unwinding will increase as short-term yields decline and volatility spikes, reducing attractiveness of risky carry positions.
predictions.expected_result: Positions sensitive to carry (e.g., high-yield ETFs, risk-on FX carry trades) show net outflows and price declines concurrent with rising short-term volatility and falling short yields.

predictions.prediction_text: Market is hedging for a potential retest of the lows heading into the data release and FOMC Minutes.
predictions.expected_result: Put option open interest and implied volatilities rise ahead of the data release/FOMC minutes; underlying indices approach or retest recent lows.

predictions.prediction_text: Market likely to become complacent expecting a dovish Fed and liquidity returning soon.
predictions.expected_result: Equity implied volatilities fall and risk-on assets rally absent dovish surprises from the Fed.

predictions.prediction_text: Fed will not be overly dovish this month unless inflation trend and its volatility stabilize.
predictions.expected_result: Fed communications and policy decisions remain neutral to slightly hawkish; market-implied easing expectations are not materially priced in.
